items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: Chris Kelly, Kid Renee, Sam Morgan. And I said, well I was long there with them.

ctx.x: You know, and who the hot ones were and who the straight ones were.
Well, the hot ones were, up and down the street. Chris Kelly, Kid Renee, Sam Morgan. And I said, well I was long there with them. And, uh, the little Carl Sidney Dutton, he was one of that bunch too.
He was a righty trumpet player.
